2024-01-01 On the functioning of Equatorial Guinea's National Centre for the Issuance of Official Documents (CNEDOGE)

facts.fact: CNEDOGE, an autonomous public entity attached to the Ministry of National Security, issues the biometric national identity document (DIP) and installs, controls and manages the issuing and verifying devices nationwide.

note: CETIS is named as responsible for the technology but the document does not say who operates or maintains it day to day.
The system named is a civil-servant register, not the national ID system.
Equipment renewal approved; no statement of who operates, maintains or owns the system.
